desk.folders.flash_next_steps.text:
The card is ready. Put it in the Raspberry Pi 5, plug in the two USB disks and power it on.

Then, in the Off The Cloud app on your phone (iOS or Android), tap "Set up a new device": it finds the Pi over Bluetooth and walks you through the rest.

desk.folders.setup_intro.text:
This prepares the SD card for a new Off The Cloud device:

1. Download the device image (about 560 MB).
2. Write it to an SD card of 8 GB or more - everything on the card is erased.
3. Delete the download.

You need a Raspberry Pi 5 with 8 GB of RAM, the SD card and two USB disks.

desk.folders.setup_not_written.text: The card was not written: writing an SD card needs administrator permission. Choose {item} again when you are ready (the download is kept).

desk.folders.setup_windows_format.text: If Windows offers to format the card, choose Cancel: Windows can't read the device's Linux partition, and that is expected.

desk.folders.upload_only_later.text: You can turn it off later from the web app or the phone app (the lock on the folder in Files); the files you deleted on this computer while it was on then come back here.

desk.folders.upload_only_two_way.text: Files you delete on this computer stay on the device and aren't downloaded again; files added or changed on the device still come down.
